findings.title: Bind the witness and its intervention to the selected CITY and validate the full protocol before credit or effects

locations.section: LIFECYCLE scripted fixture and new control/negative tests

evidence: The C report contains no selected CITY/retained-record binding. consumed_before and consumed_after are deltas of global scan.fixed.city_joined; retained and continued are also global window counts. A query that consumes another live CITY can satisfy the positive while the selected city was skipped or not reached. Query-answer equality does not establish which city box was consumed.

The changed intervention targets the first CITY_STATE after any continuation count, without requiring that current key be the selected CITY’s continued record. The missing intervention similarly chooses the first named REMOVE and performs private RELEASE before the ordinary current-positive reply validation. Neither negative requires the selected-record BEFORE-consumption prerequisite; the retained scripted negative tests pass without any candidate consumption.

The private RELEASE acknowledgement checks only result removed and empty/missing name. It bypasses the existing city reply contract’s no-p check; malformed positive/ACK data can produce effects or credit before its full immediate contract is checked.

parse_lifecycle fields() scans key=value substrings instead of consuming exact ordered rows. Unmatched garbage/blank lines can be ignored; physical triples, booleans, enum/count domains and before/after physical-field consistency are not validated. The verdict can rely on query_equal=1 even when the reported before/after fields contradict it.

The early unreached return precedes request/reply-fault checks, and an unintervened negative with no fatal also reports UNREACHED before checking earlier faults. An actual earlier protocol failure must remain a failure rather than be relabelled absent eligibility.
findings.effect: The new fixture reaches real Core services, but the present bookkeeping can credit another CITY or malformed evidence and mutate Host state before complete eligibility/ACK validation. It does not yet prove the required selected-CITY lifecycle/consumption authority.
minimum_correction: Latch the selected actual CITY and canonical retained anchor from real fixture/current child-removal and sector events or a bounded semantic-key report. Bind the BEFORE and AFTER consuming stages, both empty relinks/restatements and each negative intervention to that same canonical record. Global counts may remain telemetry only. Do not add a production API, second store or actor/geometry/time search.

Validate the current request join and complete real named-removal positive, including its own retained-key relationship, before the missing-state intervention. Validate the private RELEASE ACK under the existing removed/no-key/no-p city contract before credit. The changed-state intervention must target only the current joined restatement of the selected record.

Require genuine selected-CITY BEFORE consumption for every credited variant; AFTER consumption is required for the successful control and stays unavailable after an expected fatal. No credited intervention when the selected city was not consumed or only a competing LIVE city was consumed.

Reuse existing strict row/line/raw-triple helpers for the complete five-line grammar: exact order/keys/single spacing, no ignored material, bounded integral building count, exact booleans/enums and raw word triples. Cross-check the before/after fields against equality declarations without float normalization. Keep legitimate raw-word semantics rather than inventing a new physical solver.

Check existing request/reply faults and unrelated fatal failures before any UNREACHED classification. Add a coherent full-credit scripted positive first, then competing-CITY/missing-binding, bad positive/ACK cursor/key/state, malformed/contradictory report and fault-before-UNREACHED single-fault guards in the existing harness. No damaged native experiment or broad suite is requested.

new_fixture_source_assessment.bounded_setup: The fixture selects in a fixed source order, bounds its building array and checks report capacity before lifecycle mutation. It uses a finite box-derived segment and a neighbouring sector, then restores position and CITY child-list order. Sector enumeration order is not promised restored, so this is a terminal opt-in witness and is never followed by a physical run.

The header’s POST-LAUNCH label is imprecise; use a standalone post-warmup terminal-service schema. It is neither the BOOT failure row nor the old launched-weapon authority row.

Changed mode alters one forwarded CITY_STATE box word while leaving the Core mirror unchanged; that is a declared mirror-conformance negative, not a changed Host-geometry solver or unchanged-command claim.
new_fixture_source_assessment.postfatal_boundary: The new branch emits stored Lua counters and unavailable report fields on fatal, without new physical/counter/metrics/close calls through the poisoned Engine. Those unknown values must remain unknown and cannot prove restoration or no writes.
new_fixture_source_assessment.fp_rng_and_ownership_scope: Underlying constructor/kernel/rule arithmetic is unchanged. The opt-in fixture performs explicit test-input geometry arithmetic under the Engine entry and actual production queries, which may exercise original effectful getters. It is not an observation-only or whole-FPU/native parity claim. No second world/store, raw pointer transport or production physical fallback is added.
new_fixture_source_assessment.report_declaration_limit: sector_order_changed=1 is emitted unconditionally; treat it as the terminal non-restoration declaration, not a measured proof that a particular sector permutation changed. Normal control must compare actual physical outputs literally once the selected-CITY protocol is corrected.
